# fui palette

Y2K cybercore after aljulandani.dev: frosted, glossy plastic windows with a 1px bevel, a gel
title bar and an inset well, over a quiet network lattice and old-screen glass. Three themes;
only the colour changes. `fui mode toggle` (SUPER+SHIFT+T) cycles dark → mid → light.
Source of truth: [`tokens.toml`](tokens.toml). Design rules: [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md).

## Contrast (WCAG 2)
`theme/build.py --check` fails when a pair drops below its minimum.

| Pair | Min | dark | mid | light |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| text on desk | 4.5 | 17.7 | 12.7 | 16.2 |
| text on plastic | 4.5 | 16.5 | 13.9 | 16.6 |
| muted on desk | 4.5 | 7.0 | 6.8 | 6.5 |
| bar readouts on plastic | 4.5 | 16.5 | 7.5 | 6.7 |
| accent on desk (large text) | 3 | 12.8 | 4.8 | 7.5 |
| white title on the gel | 4.5 | 5.0 | 7.5 | 7.7 |
| nav text on white buttons | 4.5 | 5.4 | 6.3 | 7.7 |
| white on the selection | 4.5 | 5.4 | 6.3 | 7.7 |
| link on desk | 4.5 | 10.3 | 6.7 | 7.0 |
| LCD ink on LCD glass | 7 | 9.0 | 9.0 | 9.0 |
| plate ink on graphite | 7 | 10.2 | 10.2 | 10.2 |

## Type
| Role | Face |
|---|---|
| wordmark `@user` | Michroma |
| structure: labels, readouts, paths, terminals | JetBrainsMono Nerd Font |
| window titles (18px / 27px only) | ProFontIIx Nerd Font |
| LCD digits (only on LCD glass) | DSEG7 Classic |
| reading: app text | Noto Sans |
